zechariah.4.p1.b1.text: Then the angel who was speaking with me returned and woke me, as a man is awakened from his sleep.

zechariah.4.p1.b3.text: I see a solid gold lampstand … with a bowl at the top and seven lamps on it, with seven spouts to the lamps. … There are also two olive trees beside it …

zechariah.4.p1.b5.text: Do you not know what they are? … No, my lord

zechariah.4.p1.b6.text: This is the word of the LORD to Zerubbabel: Not by might nor by power, but by My Spirit, says the LORD of Hosts.

zechariah.4.p1.b7.text: What are you, O great mountain? Before Zerubbabel you will become a plain. Then he will bring forth the capstone

zechariah.4.p2.b1.text: The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house, and his hands will complete it. …

zechariah.4.p2.b2.text: For who has despised the day of small things?

zechariah.4.p2.b3.text: But these seven eyes of the LORD, which scan the whole earth, will rejoice when they see the plumb line in the hand of Zerubbabel.

zechariah.4.p2.b4.text: What are the two olive trees on the right and left of the lampstand? … What are the two olive branches beside the two gold pipes from which the golden oil pours?

zechariah.4.p2.b5.text: Do you not know what these are? … No, my lord

zechariah.4.p2.b6.text: These are the two anointed ones who are standing beside the Lord of all the earth.
